svg.title: Earth's Moon, north up
svg.desc: Static vector isophotes derived from NASA's north-up full Moon rendering, recoloured with warm ivory highlands, soft taupe lunar seas and pale cream crater rays. Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio; LROC WAC mosaic, NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University. Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5048/ (phase_full.1571_print.jpg).
